Jaylen Wells scored the Grizzlies' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 14 times in 67 starts, or 21% of the games they started. Jaren Jackson Jr. was next with 11. The Grizzlies made the game's first field goal in 44% of their 80 games and won 39% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
